Bid quoting purchase year of vehicle other than 2024 or 2025 or 2026 shall be rejected. Documentary evidenc e of purchase year of vehicle must be enclosed with bid document. 2. The vehicle must not have run more than 25,000 Kms. Documentary evidence odometer showin g distance travelled by the vehicle must be enclosed with bid document. 3. The vehicle must be brought to the office at the time of evaluation of technical bids for physical inspection at O/o the Pr. CCIT, WB & Sikkim, Aayakar Bhawan, P-7, Chowringhee Square, Kolkata-7 00069 4. The O/o the Pr. CCIT, WB & Sikkim reserves right to transfer the contract, within its valid period, to another office in Kolkata station for use as staff car / operational vehicle, as the case may be, u nder the charge of PCCIT/CCIT/PCIT/CIT. 5. The agreement / contract between the department and the vendor is liable to be cancelled by a notice of 15 days by the department. 6. If there is more than one L1 bidder, then at the stage of evaluation of financial bids, the buyer

will have to use ‘Run L1 Selection’ feature wherein the system would randomly identify a L1 seller. It works on pseudorandom number generator based on linear congruential algorithm. 7. Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 3 months beyond the initial contract duration (subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent). 8. The driver must be in proper uniform and his conduct should be polite and courteous. 9. Monthly distance covered may vary between 2000 kms. and 2500kms. . 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
